message: RDS instances must have storage encryption enabled.
fix: Set storage_encrypted = true.

message: RDS instances must not be publicly accessible.
fix: Set publicly_accessible = false or remove it.

message: RDS backup retention period must be at least 7 days.
fix: Set backup_retention_period to 7 or more.

message: RDS instances should have deletion protection enabled.
fix: Set deletion_protection = true.

message: RDS clusters must have storage encryption enabled.
fix: Set storage_encrypted = true.

message: RDS clusters should have deletion protection enabled.
fix: Set deletion_protection = true.

message: RDS cluster backup retention period must be at least 7 days.
fix: Set backup_retention_period to 7 or more.

message: EBS volumes must be encrypted.
fix: Set encrypted = true.

message: EFS file systems must be encrypted.
fix: Set encrypted = true.

message: EFS file systems should use a customer-managed KMS key.
fix: Set kms_key_id to a customer-managed KMS key ARN.

message: ElastiCache replication groups must have encryption at rest enabled.
fix: Set at_rest_encryption_enabled = "true".

message: ElastiCache replication groups must have encryption in transit enabled.
fix: Set transit_encryption_enabled = true.

message: Redshift clusters must be encrypted.
fix: Set encrypted = "true" or remove it.

message: Redshift clusters must not be publicly accessible.
fix: Set publicly_accessible = false or remove it.

message: Load balancer listeners must use HTTPS or TLS.
fix: Set protocol = "HTTPS" (ALB) or "TLS" (NLB) with a certificate.

message: S3 buckets must not use the public-read ACL.
fix: Remove acl or set it to private.

message: S3 buckets must not use the public-read-write ACL.
fix: Remove acl or set it to private.
